prompt: How to setup traefik on server M to route trafic to two other instances of traefik running on two separate servers, servers A and B. Traefik on server M needs to be aware of all services that servers A and B are runnig via auto discovery.
response: To set up traefik on server M to route traffic to instances on servers A and B, you can use Docker labels for service discovery. On servers A and B, label your traefik services with `traefik.enable=true` and `traefik.backend=serverA` or `traefik.backend=serverB`. On server M, configure traefik to use the Docker provider and set up a front-end router with the appropriate backends. This setup allows server M to automatically discover and route traffic to services on servers A and B.
